asr.full_text: How can you make multiple profits if you are a member of BitClub? In this video we give you an idea of how to do it. We have a highly profitable concept of provisions. In large part it is financed from discounts that miners give us because of our increasing demand The creation of an account to be a member requires an only payment of 99 dólares. You can now choose from three different mining pools Creating a partnership account will cost only $99. Now you can choose among three different mining pools. Pool 1 will cost you $500. It will be valued at 3 credits in the planned spending. Pool 2 costs $1000. It implies twice the amount of software and is equivalent to 6 credits. Pool 3 costs $ 2,000. Here we have four times as much software capabilities that in Pool 1 and which we rate at12 credits. The Founder Pool contains participation on all three Pools and is 3,500 dollars. Equivales to 21 credits and guarantees top pay provision payment, in the first moment. For every participation in the pool, the Bitglod physically acquires IT hardware that will be integrated in our mining facilities. There are 5 different forms of financial aid in our fiscal plan. The Evola Bonus is a 5 bonus of 5 to 8%. The Cycle Bonus generates Bitcoins for worth $200 per cycle. The Merchant Bonus generates Bitcoins for worth $10 per cycle from each member of the team, as well as generation bonus and infinity bonus. The Level Up Bonus, or instant bonus pays 5-8% on every purchase of new participant by your team's members. Shared participant automatic bids take on an additional 18% The cycle bonus is paid every 24 hours and is the main part of your revenue. Our club system is based on a binary structure. This means that your account rests on two pillars, let's say legs. Now you have the option of placing another account on the left leg and another on the right leg. These accounts, for their part, can continue to open. An account on the left branch and another on the Right axis, and so on. This means, your money will be spent by one left team, followed by one of the right team. Once you've added 15 credits, which is equivalent to $2,500 in both teams, you'll get a $200 salary, on 24-hour billing period. The benefit of world transactions arrived in your main accounts, choosing the ideal strategy, you can invoice several cycles daily and they are possible from the first day onwards. By taking a high-end basis in the system, you may even increase the daily cycles for a each account to 10. That would bring you up to $2,000 daily for each of your accounts, only in the CYCLE BONUS. As a member of the BITCLUB you are free to have as many accounts as you want, and you do not have to comply with any monthly commitment to receive your savings. This allows you to multiply your earnings with the same investment, placing several accounts strategically. Here you have a perfect example. You start by activating your first account. That main account, on the other hand, promotes an account to the right and another one to the left, and now you have three accounts. Now, make sure that each of the two and three accounts activate two more. That's four and five to the right and 6 and 7 to the left. And you have 7 accounts as position points. Now it's time to include other club members. It isn't hard. In this video we'll show you how to do it in our videos. You only have to hand over the information to you. By training your team, sales that lead to the next provisions are generated. Let's say you winning 8 new members with 15 credits with 4, 5, 6, 7 credits under your accounts both to the right and left, now you have in each of those four accounts 15 credits to right and 15 left, therefore you charge a 200-dollar bond for each one of the 4 accounts. Let's look at your 2 and 3 accounts, now have 30 credits to right on the left, so you're getting 2 cycles, so you make 400 for each account. Your top ten account now has 60 credits on the right and 60 on the left, this equals four cycles and 800 dollars. As you can see, your three accounts gain money without doing anything to gain money. The only requirement to keep your profits is to know how the system works, and a good strategy. If we stick to the example above, you would also charge an immediate $1000 bonus to anyone, as well as an 80$ matchit bonus, In total, a profit of 3,500$ is received. The price will be 20,000 dollars from the hardware purchase. The automated purchases of fractionated participation are inherent to the system, and brings you other continuous provisions over many years. Our singular system are distinguished for a single investment, no monthly or concomitant expenses and a long life record of status.

textual.potential_relevance: A requested payment is directly linked to membership, pool credits, and stated financial returns, creating a payment-and-reward relationship for later assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the business, mining activity, credits, or stated benefits exist or operate as described.

visual.limitations: These frames do not establish any explicit viewer instruction, payment recipient, transfer step, eligibility terms, or real transaction outcome.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes paid BitClub participation through a $99 membership payment and claims that accounts, team expansion, and strategically placed multiple accounts can generate passive earnings. It presents credit thresholds, salaries, bonuses, branching payouts, and earnings of up to $2,000 daily per account as benefits of the paid structure. The material does not independently verify the mining activity, actual payouts, participant losses, or whether the illustrated earnings were achieved.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Paid pool participation is explicitly linked to mining hardware and recurring Bitcoin-related cycle payouts. The source gives pool prices, describes hardware integrated into mining facilities, and states that a cycle bonus generates Bitcoin with a dollar value. The presentation describes a binary team structure in which credits from two teams, additional club members, multiple accounts, and member-linked bonuses determine earnings.
